Mia Chen: Heads-up — we're seeing a spike in 'ambiguous_tool_output' rejects in the dashboard after the v2 toolformat deprecation rollout. Not clear if it's the validator or an adapter. :eyes:
Jon Patel: Can you paste an example payload?
Mia Chen: Sure — one of the rejects looks like this:
```json
{"tool": "search_v1", "result": ["id:123", "score:0.9"], "metadata": null}
```
Mia Chen: Previously adapters returned object results; now some older integrations still send arrays. Validator flags it but telemetry counts as generic reject.
Alejandra Ruiz: That's the old bridge adapter. We started migrating partners two weeks ago; some clients still on pinned image.
Kevin Liao: Ops-bot just fired an alert? ops-bot: "Alert 7231: schema_reject_rate elevated on route /invoke/toolhook — 4x baseline"
ops-bot: alert context attached: sampling id=ZQ12, last 100 rejects showed 63% array-vs-object mismatches.
Sam W: ConsoleBot also shows a huge 'other' bucket for reject reasons in the sampling UI. We can't drill into array-vs-object without a new breakdown.
Ryan T: Is the validator able to emit a reject_reason tag that we can use for routing and billing? Right now billing sees "validation:reject" and attributes cost to customer but not root cause.
Priya S: Product: we need to avoid misbilling. If a partner is sending legacy format, we should flag but not charge them for validation rejects until notified. Need policy sync.
Jon Patel: Technical ask — can we modify the handshake to include a "compat_mode" header for known bridges? That would let validator allow array payloads for whitelisted clients.
Alejandra Ruiz: We can do a soft-accept path in the adapter layer, but the runtime currently performs schema validation post-deserialization for security. Adding a compat header will need SRE signoff for attack surface.
Kevin Liao: Short term: can we change telemetry to emit validator_subcode like "TOOL_ARRAY_INSTEAD_OF_OBJECT"? That helps console dashboards and billing rules. Low-risk and non-breaking.
Mia Chen: Agree — actionable telemetry first. Then a policy decision for billing/rollout.
Sam W: I can whip up a patch to attach subcodes in the validator and pipe them into the existing sampling kafka topic. Should be a small change: add enum + mapper.
Jon Patel: Please add a schema example to the PR with both failing and accepted shapes so reviewers see intent.
Priya S: Also need a note in the console: "Legacy tool payloads may be accepted under compat mode — contact support" so customers aren't surprised.
Ryan T: For rollout: propose 3 phases — (1) emit subcode only, (2) surface subcode in console and update billing rules to exclude validation rejects for whitelisted clients, (3) flip strict mode off for whitelisted clients and then schedule deprecation.
Alejandra Ruiz: Phase 2 requires a console change to allow filtering by validator_subcode. Console team, any objections?
ConsoleBot: New request created — #CON-1128: Add "Validator subcode" filter to Invocations dashboard. Assigned to console eng backlog.
ConsoleBot: ETA placeholder: 2 sprints.
Kevin Liao: If console ETA is long, we should still push telemetry so BI can run ad-hoc queries to give ownership.
Sam W: I'll open the validator PR and include config flag `emit_subcodes=true`. Will default to false in prod until review.
Mia Chen: Ops: once PR lands, can SRE enable sampling of these subcodes and route them to the schema-debug topic?
Kevin Liao: Yes, SRE can open a temporary router rule. But add a rate cap — these payloads can be noisy.
Jon Patel: Security note: any compat header must be authenticated. We can't let arbitrary callers opt-out.
Alejandra Ruiz: We'll only allow compat headers from partners with a signed client cert or reserved API key namespace.
Priya S: I'll coordinate comms to partners and support with a two-week notice window before enforcement.
Ryan T: Telemetry items checklist I want in the PR: 1) validator_subcode field added to kafka schema, 2) sampling key unchanged, 3) unit tests for mapping, 4) docs in infra-runbook.
Sam W: Added to PR description.
Mia Chen: One more ask — can console show a one-click "Request migration help" button next to the sample event? Product thinks that will lower churn.
Priya S: Good idea. I'll file a design ticket and loop solutions eng.
Kevin Liao: Timeline: Sam to open PR today, SRE to stand up router for sampling after PR merge, console filter in ~2 sprints, partner comms start after subcode emission validated.
Jon Patel: For long-term, we should add a validation guidance doc in the docs site with exact accepted shapes and migration examples. Link it from console samples.
Mia Chen: Thanks everyone. Let's sync in the validator-standup at 3pm if anything blocks. :shipit:
Priya S: Noted. I'll join.
ConsoleBot: Ticket #CON-1128 updated: blocked-by #ENG-994 (validator subcodes).
